content:
hannah: Heads up 1 Quasar Analytics sent invoice QA-4602 but it references PO 9988 which we never issued to them. They also marked it URGENT for cloud credits. PDF: https://redwood-drive/finance/invoices/QA-4602.pdf

approvals-bot: Invoice ingested (inv_20240522_7890). Flag: `po_mismatch`. Routed to omar_fin per default vendor routing.

omar_fin: Pulled invoice. Amount $23,400. Looks like they billed for "cloud credits (prepaid)" and referenced PO 9988. Our PO 9988 belongs to a different vendor (Quanta Labs). Procurement please confirm. GL guidance requested if we hold.

nisha_proc: Running PO lookup... PO 9988 = Quanta Labs (closed). Quasar has PO 10021 for professional services (committed $20,000) but nothing for prepaid credits. Tagging @cloud-ops and @legal_ops.

cloud-ops: We requested cloud credits earlier via procurement but it was never approved; budget didn't cover prepaid vendor credits. No acceptance of prepaid credits on our side.

legal_ops: Contract review: Quasar SOW does not include prepaid credits unless signed amendment. We should not pay until vendor provides valid PO reference or signed amendment. If vendor claims PO 9988 is ours, get proof.

omar_fin: Placing invoice on hold in AP: HOLD_INV_2012345678. Note: vendor referenced wrong PO; billed for unapproved cloud credits. Partial payment 50% was never released (it shows as pending by vendor portal, not paid). Will block auto-remit.

hannah: FYI vendor sent an email claiming AR was told verbally to bill against PO 9988. They attached an email thread but it looks like internal quoting to a partner. I'm drafting reply asking for signed amendment or corrected invoice referencing PO 10021 with line-level detail.

nisha_proc: Action items: (1) Proc to request corrected invoice referencing PO 10021 if charge relates to PS and amount matches; (2) If non-PS charge (cloud credits) require signed amendment from Legal; (3) If vendor insists on PO 9988, request evidence that Redwood authorized that PO for Quasar (we think it's a mismatch). Deadline: 48 hours.

omar_fin: AP note added: "Hold reason: PO mismatch + unapproved prepaid credits. Contact AR: ar@quasar.com. Do not remit until cleared by procurement + legal."

legal_ops: If vendor pushes, we will draft a non-payment response referencing contract clause and request indemnity for unauthorized billing. Also consider vendor manager escalation.

hannah: I emailed AR and CC'd vendor manager. Asked for either: corrected invoice referencing PO 10021 OR signed amendment for cloud credits OR formal admission of mistake and credit memo.

approvals-bot: Routing update: invoice reassigned to nisha_proc for procurement validation. audit_ref: AUD-QA-2112.

omar_fin: Thanks all. If vendor provides partial credit memos we can consider paying the undisputed portion (PS lines) and hold the rest. Keep thread updated.

nisha_proc: Will update after vendor reply. If no reply in 48h escalate to vendor manager and open a dispute. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
